title.zh: 带宽成本经济学：为什么“永久免费、不限速不限量”在物理网络规律上绝不可能存在？
title.en: Bandwidth Economics: Why 'Unlimited Free High-Speed VPNs' Break the Laws of Physics

cluster.zh: 免费 VPN 风险雷达与供应链剖析

description.zh: 从全球海底光缆铺设投资、IDC 机房电力制冷能耗到 Tier-1 运营商中继带宽结算的真实经济账本，彻底揭穿“永久免费高速代理”在物理学与商业世界中的荒谬谎言。
description.en: Analyzing submarine cable capital expenditures, datacenter cooling/power overhead, and transit settlement math to demonstrate why free unlimited high-speed proxies are an economic impossibility.
